summary: Lewis Hamilton and Ferrari's Charles Leclerc clash for supremacy as Aston Martin's transformative upgrade threatens to shake up the established order at the Hungaroring. Fernando Alonso's optimism about the package redesign sets up a pivotal test of whether the team's mechanical gains can propel him back into contention and influence his future at the squad. A strong result for Hamilton or Ferrari here could prove decisive in cementing championship momentum heading into the sport's second half, while an Aston Martin breakthrough would reshape the midfield hierarchy entirely.
